address: 76-77 South Parade, Ealing, London, W4 5LF, United Kingdom
bio: With its part-mirrored walls, belle époque pictures and vintage brasserie styling, Le Vacherin brings a little bit of France to its West London neighbourhood. The menu has the classical French slant you would expect, allowing you to get your fix of 'escargots' or 'longe de lapin' without leaving the country. It's all fresh, flavoursome and prepared with obvious care, while the 'prix fixe' menu offers great value for money. The chateaubriand to share is a popular choice....
